sn55.34:1.2: cattārimāni bhikkhave, devānaṃ devapadāni avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānaṃ pariyodapanāya.
sn55.34:2.2: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.34:2.3: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.34:2.4: idha paṭhamaṃ devānaṃ devapadaṃ avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānaṃ pariyodapanāya.
sn55.34:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, ariyasāvako dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti: svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo …pe… paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī”ti. idaṃ dutiyānaṃ devānaṃ devapadaṃ avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ pariyodapanāya. puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, ariyasāvako
sn55.34:3.2: saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti: “supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā”ti. idaṃ tatiyaṃ devānaṃ devapadaṃ avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātaṃ sattānaṃ pariyodapanāya.
sn55.34:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, ariyasāvako ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.34:4.2: idaṃ catutthaṃ devānaṃ devapadaṃ avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānaṃ pariyodapanāya.
sn55.34:4.3: imāni kho bhikkhave, cattāri devānaṃ devapadāni avisuddhānaṃ sattānaṃ visuddhiyā apariyodātānaṃ sattānaṃ pariyodapanāyāti.
